title: Facilities Engineering Intern (Electrical Power)
description:
Job Details:
Job Description:
The Role and Impact
As a Facilities Engineering Undergraduate Intern, you will play a pivotal role in supporting the planning, implementation, and maintenance of Intel's building infrastructure and systems. Your day-to-day activities will involve analyzing operational processes, energy usage, and safety compliance, while contributing to facility expansion and layout design efforts. This hands-on experience will build your technical skills as you collaborate with engineering teams to improve efficiency, ensure regulatory adherence, and support Intel business goals.
Business Group
Intel Foundry is at the heart of driving innovation and operational excellence, providing advanced manufacturing services that support Intel's broader business objectives. The Facilities Operations group focuses on maintaining and optimizing critical infrastructure, enabling Intel to deliver cutting-edge technology to customers. Joining this team offers the opportunity to learn, grow, and contribute to a dynamic environment that values collaboration and continuous improvement.
Key Responsibilities
- Assist in the planning, implementation, and maintenance of building infrastructure and systems.
- Analyze operational processes, energy use, and safety compliance to identify improvement opportunities.
- Support facility expansion projects and layout designs to optimize efficiency.
- Collaborate with engineering teams to ensure adherence to regulatory and safety standards.
- Contribute to projects aimed at improving operational effectiveness and sustainability within Intel facilities.
Qualifications:
Minimum Qualifications
- Pursuing a bachelor's degree in electrical engineering.
- Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team.
- Enthusiasm for developing practical engineering solutions to support growth and innovation.
- Able to commit to a minimum internship period of 5 to 6 months, subject to university/college internship requirements and academic calendar.
We're looking for passionate individuals eager to explore their future careers and contribute to impactful projects in a dynamic and inclusive environment. Apply today to take the first step in building your career with Intel.
Take the next step in your academic journey by joining Intel's Facilities Operations team, where you will gain practical experience, develop technical expertise, and contribute to meaningful projects that shape Intel's future.
